title: Missing magnets
text: Missing magnets. The main box is great quality, the side boxes are as well, I’m disappointed that mine is missing the magnets on the large side box to connect it to the main box.

product_metadata.title: Bamboo Ziplock Bag Storage Organizer and Dispenser for for Kitchen Drawer Bamboo Baggie Organizers Holderfor Gallon, Quart, Sandwich and Snack Bags
features: ZIPLOCK BAG STORAGE ORGANIZER - Bamboo baggie organizer is designed to organize your food storage bags. It allows you to easily store messy food storage bags in your drawer by category, keeping your drawer tidy and orderly!

FRIENDLY DESIGN - The fully assembled one-piece solid bamboo box does not require assembly. The top cover is openable, and the powerful magnet connects the cover to the box, making it easy for you to fill the storage bag.

WIDE COMPATIBILITY - There is a large enough capacity for daily use, it can perfectly store most brands of sandwich bags, quart bags, snack bags and gallon bags. It is very suitable for optimal use and therefore is not compatible with slider bags.

NATURAL BAMBOO MATERIAL - The ziplock bag container made of natural bamboo, the surface is painted and finely polished by hand, which can be used in long time. Engraved letters with gallons, quarts, sandwiches and snacks are convenient for sorting. The natural wood color ensures that it matches most kitchen cabinets.
DIMENSIONS【Dimensions】12" L, 12" W, 3.15" H, please measure the size of your drawer in advance, of course, you can also put it on the kitchen countertop or storage shelf.
